parts.label: Exhaust Manifold (Right Bank)
parts.function: Tubular manifold collecting exhaust from the three right-bank cylinders. On the 987.2 the manifolds were redesigned with enlarged tube cross sections, nearly equal pipe lengths and the main catalytic converter integrated into the manifold.

parts.label: Exhaust Manifold (Left Bank)
parts.function: Tubular manifold collecting exhaust from the three left-bank cylinders. On the 987.2 the manifolds were redesigned with enlarged tube cross sections, nearly equal pipe lengths and the main catalytic converter integrated into the manifold.

parts.label: Exhaust Manifold Gasket (Right)
parts.function: Gasket sealing the right-bank exhaust manifold-to-cylinder-head joint against combustion gas leakage.

parts.label: Exhaust Manifold Gasket (Left)
parts.function: Gasket sealing the left-bank exhaust manifold-to-cylinder-head joint against combustion gas leakage.

parts.label: Exhaust Manifold Studs & Nuts (Right, x3)
parts.function: Threaded studs pressed into the right cylinder head with self-locking nuts that clamp the exhaust manifold flange (manifold nuts 23 Nm).

parts.label: Exhaust Manifold Studs & Nuts (Left, x3)
parts.function: Threaded studs pressed into the left cylinder head with self-locking nuts that clamp the exhaust manifold flange (manifold nuts 23 Nm).

parts.label: Decoupling Element (Right Connecting Pipe)
parts.function: Corrugated flexible section in the right connecting pipe ahead of the rear silencer, absorbing engine movement and thermal expansion of the long mid-engine exhaust run.

parts.label: Decoupling Element (Left Connecting Pipe)
parts.function: Corrugated flexible section in the left connecting pipe ahead of the rear silencer, absorbing engine movement and thermal expansion of the long mid-engine exhaust run.

parts.label: Main Catalytic Converter (Right, integrated)
parts.function: Main catalytic converter integrated into the right manifold (987.2) — first of two ceramic monoliths in series. Larger diameter than the earlier pre-cats for lower backpressure; the 987.1 instead carried its main cats inside the rear silencers.

parts.label: Main Catalytic Converter (Left, integrated)
parts.function: Main catalytic converter integrated into the left manifold (987.2) — first of two ceramic monoliths in series. Larger diameter than the earlier pre-cats for lower backpressure; the 987.1 instead carried its main cats inside the rear silencers.

parts.label: Heat Shield — Integrated Cat (Right)
parts.function: Heat shield wrapped around the right manifold-integrated catalytic converter to protect the mid-engine bay components from radiant heat.

parts.label: Heat Shield — Integrated Cat (Left)
parts.function: Heat shield wrapped around the left manifold-integrated catalytic converter to protect the mid-engine bay components from radiant heat.

parts.label: Heat Shield — Underbody / Mid-Section
parts.function: Large underbody heat shield over the integrated cats and connecting pipes, critical on the mid-engine layout to protect fuel lines, wiring and the body floor from exhaust heat.

parts.label: Oxygen Sensor LSU 4.9 (Right, Upstream)
parts.function: Broadband lambda sensor LSU 4.9 (fitted worldwide on the 987.2) ahead of the right catalytic converter, providing closed-loop fuelling feedback to the DME.

parts.label: Oxygen Sensor LSU 4.9 (Left, Upstream)
parts.function: Broadband lambda sensor LSU 4.9 (fitted worldwide on the 987.2) ahead of the left catalytic converter, providing closed-loop fuelling feedback to the DME.

parts.label: Oxygen Sensor LSF (Right, behind first monolith)
parts.function: Step-type lambda sensor LSF behind the first catalytic monolith on the right bank, monitoring converter efficiency for the DME.

parts.label: Oxygen Sensor LSF (Left, behind first monolith)
parts.function: Step-type lambda sensor LSF behind the first catalytic monolith on the left bank, monitoring converter efficiency for the DME.

parts.label: Connecting Pipes — Silencer Crossover (x2)
parts.function: The two connecting pipes between the left and right rear silencers that mix the exhaust gases from cylinder banks 1 and 2 before they escape from the tailpipes.

parts.label: Second Catalytic Monolith (per bank)
parts.function: Second ceramic monolith in series inside each manifold-integrated converter housing (987.2 concept: one larger main cat with two monoliths per bank, replacing the 987.1 underbody/silencer cats).

parts.label: Heat Shield — Crossover Section
parts.function: Heat shield protecting the rear body panel and bumper area from the radiant heat of the silencer crossover pipes and mixing chamber.

parts.label: Centre Mixing Chamber / Tailpipe Connection
parts.function: Central connection between the two rear silencers where the mixed gases of both banks are carried to the tailpipes — the classic 987 centre-exit layout.

parts.label: Silencer Inlet Gasket (Right)
parts.function: Sealing ring at the joint between the right connecting pipe and the front-outboard inlet of the right rear silencer.

parts.label: Silencer Inlet Gasket (Left)
parts.function: Sealing ring at the joint between the left connecting pipe and the front-outboard inlet of the left rear silencer.

parts.label: Rear Silencer (Right)
parts.function: Right rear silencer, laid diagonally from its front-outboard inlet to its rear-inboard outlet. On the 987.2 the main cats were removed from the silencers and the internals redesigned for a fuller, rounder tone; 987.1 silencers still housed the main catalytic converters.

parts.label: Rear Silencer (Left)
parts.function: Left rear silencer, laid diagonally from its front-outboard inlet to its rear-inboard outlet. On the 987.2 the main cats were removed from the silencers and the internals redesigned for a fuller, rounder tone; 987.1 silencers still housed the main catalytic converters.

parts.label: Sport Exhaust (PSE) Bypass Valve — option
parts.function: Vacuum-actuated bypass valve of the optional Porsche Sport Exhaust, opening an alternative path around silencer baffling for a louder, sportier note. A sticking valve is usually a perished vacuum line.

parts.label: PSE Valve Actuator (Vacuum Unit)
parts.function: Pneumatic actuator canister that translates vacuum into mechanical displacement to open and close the PSE bypass valve flap.

parts.label: Tailpipe Tip (Right of centre pair)
parts.function: Right tip of the central tailpipe. S models (3.4) run a brushed stainless twin tailpipe designed as a true twin-pipe system with two separate pipe connections (987.2); base 2.9 models use a single enlarged oval tip instead.

parts.label: Tailpipe Tip (Left of centre pair)
parts.function: Left tip of the central tailpipe. S models (3.4) run a brushed stainless twin tailpipe designed as a true twin-pipe system with two separate pipe connections (987.2); base 2.9 models use a single enlarged oval tip instead.

parts.label: Exhaust Hanger (Right)
parts.function: Rubber hanger suspending the right rear silencer from the body (hanger bolts 23 Nm). Perished hangers are a common 987 inspection find.

parts.label: Exhaust Hanger (Left)
parts.function: Rubber hanger suspending the left rear silencer from the body (hanger bolts 23 Nm). Perished hangers are a common 987 inspection find.

parts.label: PSE Vacuum Line
parts.function: Vacuum supply line routing actuating vacuum from the intake side to the PSE bypass valve actuator.

parts.label: Exhaust Pipe Clamp
parts.function: Band clamp securing the connecting-pipe-to-silencer joint (clamp nuts 23 Nm), preventing leaks and relative movement.

parts.label: Exhaust Clamping Sleeve
parts.function: Slip-on clamping sleeve joining exhaust pipe sections at the silencer inlet connections.

parts.label: Lambda Probe Wiring Holder
parts.function: Bracket that supports and positions the lambda sensor wiring harness along the exhaust routing near the integrated cats.

parts.label: Rear Silencer Holder / Bracket
parts.function: Steel holder bridging above the two rear silencers, attaching the silencer assembly to the body structure.

parts.label: Exhaust Manifold Bracket
parts.function: Support bracket that braces the exhaust manifold against vibration and thermal movement.
